description: Final branch-only audit regression from zaq-jrg.51. ServerManager still forwards :connect_module to Factory after Factory migrated to :node_router_module, so the branch-added startup/invalidation ordering test no longer blocks at the credential boundary. Update ServerManager to forward only the NodeRouter boundary seam and replace BlockingConnect with a blocking NodeRouter stub that returns the confidential Engine action response shape. Tests first/acceptance: ordering test observes block, queued invalidation completes after dependency registration, no direct Connect override remains, focused server-manager suite and mix q pass. Action reuse: reuse the new :resolve_ai_runtime_credential Engine action contract; no new action.
title: [zaq-jrg.54] Preserve ServerManager credential dispatch test seam
